MutationContext.description: Metadata every mutation must carry so retries and stale edits are safe.

description: Request payload for the `ticket.spec.move` command: a draft, unpinned Ticket moves its Spec attachment to another Spec of its own Project (DR-DE-05). A pinned or executed Ticket stays where it stands (DR-DE-06).

spec_id.description: The Spec of the same Project the Ticket moves to.

ticket_id.description: The Ticket whose Spec attachment moves.

title: TicketSpecMoveRequest
